description: ryukoku-writing: active only for a folder that carries .ryukoku/config.yml (found from the target path, the session folder or one or two levels below it). Deny AI writes to the manuscript, .ryukoku/, the tools, the student's questions and thinking log, with every tool including Bash; detect changes made during AI tool calls (msguard) and log them in the chained AI-use log; stop prompts that contain personal data; add reasons and alternatives for ghostwriting and question-delegation requests; log searches automatically; apply the course AI policy to tools.
